subject: changing the displayed name of facets

messages.author: 4b93c2979809e85a
messages.subject: changing the displayed name of facets
parts:
I want separate graphs for each value of the variable "coefficient".
Specifying ggplot(...., formula=coefficient~beta ...) basically works
(using ggplot, not ggplot2, package), but the labelling of the rows does
not. The constructed labels are things like "coefficient: beta0"--too
long to fit in available space.

How can I get control of the labels, or just remove the leading
"coefficient: "?

?ggplot refers me to reshape for the formula argument, but the relation
between the two functions is not obvious to me.

I can not easily switch to ggplot2.

Thanks.
Ross
